26typedef struct sIpv4Addr {
27 uint8_t oct[IP_ADDR_LEN];
28 void struct_swap() {}
29 void struct_init() { std::memset(oct, 0, IP_ADDR_LEN); }
30 bool operator==(sIpv4Addr const &rhs) const
31 {
32 return (0 == std::memcmp(this->oct, rhs.oct, IP_ADDR_LEN));
33 }
34 bool operator!=(sIpv4Addr const &rhs) const { return !(rhs == *this); }
35} __attribute__((packed)) sIpv4Addr;

37typedef struct sScanResult {
38 sMacAddr mac;
39 uint8_t channel;
40 int8_t rssi;
41 void struct_swap() {}
42 void struct_init()
43 {
44 mac.struct_init();
45 channel = 0;
46 rssi = 0;
47 }
48 bool operator==(sScanResult const &rhs) const
49 {
50 return (channel == rhs.channel && rssi == rhs.rssi && mac == rhs.mac);
51 }
52 bool operator!=(sScanResult const &rhs) const { return !(rhs == *this); }
53} __attribute__((packed)) sScanResult;
